scope: Source-bounded contextual knowledge for future graph and DSL research; not calculation data, production rules, scores or personalized readings.

provenanceBoundary.independence: All K13 statements derive from three volumes of the same named work and do not constitute independent confirmation.
provenanceBoundary.rights: Bounded review of pinned public Wikisource revisions; only short locators and independently written neutral paraphrases are retained.

conditions: Tử Vi is considered in Mệnh or Quan Lộc
Tả Phụ/Hữu Bật support is present
contextualStatements.traditionalDescription: The source treats supporting assistants as an explicit contextual requirement when discussing Tử Vi in the named palace contexts.
contextualStatements.sourceLocator: 諸星問答論 > 問紫微所主若何; revision 7913704, raw lines 219–228
unresolvedDependencies: meaning of the source's three-palace phrase
limitations: No status, occupation or personal outcome is retained.

conditions: Thái Dương is considered in Quan Lộc
support from the relevant period context must also be reviewed
contextualStatements.traditionalDescription: The source associates Thái Dương with Quan Lộc but warns that a three-direction reading should not be applied without period support.
contextualStatements.sourceLocator: 諸星問答論 > 問太陽所主若何; revision 7913704, raw lines 266–267
limitations: No career, rank, family or event conclusion is retained.

conditions: Tử Vi state is reviewed
supporting and opposing surrounding stars are reviewed
contextualStatements.traditionalDescription: The source distinguishes miếu/vượng from hãm and requires the surrounding supportive or adverse context to be considered with the state.
contextualStatements.sourceLocator: 諸星問答論 > 問紫微所主若何; revision 7913704, raw lines 219–224
limitations: Does not admit a universal state value or inference polarity.

conditions: Thiên Cơ is evaluated in a source-described miếu/vượng or hãm context
contextualStatements.traditionalDescription: The source contrasts Thiên Cơ as having force in miếu/vượng contexts and lacking force in hãm contexts.
contextualStatements.sourceLocator: 諸星問答論 > 問天機所主如何; revision 7913704, raw lines 251–262
limitations: No trait, occupation or outcome is inferred from the state contrast.

conditions: Thiên Cơ and Thiên Lương are considered together
assistant or literary stars may join the context
contextualStatements.traditionalDescription: The source treats the Thiên Cơ–Thiên Lương pairing as context-sensitive and separately names assistant and literary stars as supporting participants.
contextualStatements.sourceLocator: 諸星問答論 > 問天機所主如何; revision 7913704, raw lines 251–252
unresolvedDependencies: whether each phrase means co-location or aspect
limitations: The source's occupation and status outcomes are excluded.

conditions: Vũ Khúc is evaluated with Lộc/Mã or with Phá Quân/Tham Lang
other supportive or adverse stars must be retained
contextualStatements.traditionalDescription: The source contrasts a Lộc–Mã context with Phá Quân/Tham Lang contexts and explicitly makes the assessment depend on the wider supportive or adverse grouping.
contextualStatements.sourceLocator: 諸星問答論 > 問武曲星所主為何; revision 7913704, raw lines 280–281
unresolvedDependencies: identity of Lộc in each phrase
limitations: No wealth, loss, health or conduct prediction is retained.

conditions: Mệnh is reviewed first
Thiên Di, Tài Bạch and Quan Lộc are then reviewed through the source's Tam phương context
contextualStatements.traditionalDescription: The source presents Mệnh and the Thiên Di–Tài Bạch–Quan Lộc group as linked stages of a broader chart review.
contextualStatements.sourceLocator: 談星要論; revision 2268626, raw lines 7–12
limitations: A source-described review sequence is methodology, not a production reasoning rule.

conditions: Phúc Đức is examined for named transformations, void terms and state
Tài Bạch is examined as its opposing context in this source
contextualStatements.traditionalDescription: The source explicitly links review of Phúc Đức to an opposing Tài Bạch context while retaining state, transformation and void conditions.
contextualStatements.sourceLocator: 談星要論; revision 2268626, raw line 11
unresolvedDependencies: meaning of the named void terms
limitations: No financial, wellbeing or personal conclusion is retained.

conditions: Hóa Lộc is considered in Mệnh or Quan Lộc
Hóa Khoa and Hóa Quyền are present in the source-described relation
contextualStatements.traditionalDescription: The source evaluates Hóa Lộc contextually with Hóa Khoa and Hóa Quyền in the named palaces rather than as an isolated label.
contextualStatements.sourceLocator: 諸星問答論 > 問化祿星所主若何; revision 7913704, raw lines 421–423
limitations: No office, wealth or favourable outcome is retained.

conditions: Hóa Quyền is considered
Kình Dương, Đà La, void/disruption terms or other named adverse context is present
contextualStatements.traditionalDescription: The source qualifies its Hóa Quyền discussion with an explicit adverse-star/void context, so the transformation cannot be normalized as uniformly favourable.
contextualStatements.sourceLocator: 諸星問答論 > 問化權星所主若何; revision 7913704, raw lines 425–427
unresolvedDependencies: mapping of 耗使 and 劫空 to catalog entities
limitations: No rank, legal event or gendered outcome is retained.

conditions: Each named period is reviewed separately
pairwise meetings and clashes are then reviewed
contextualStatements.traditionalDescription: The source requires Đại hạn, Tiểu hạn and Thái Tuế to be considered both individually and in pairwise context before a judgement.
contextualStatements.sourceLocator: 論二限太歲吉凶; revision 2268626, raw lines 109–110
limitations: No scoring, event or personalised conclusion is admitted.

conditions: Thái Tuế is the annual context under review
Tam phương and Đối chiếu star contexts are examined
contextualStatements.traditionalDescription: The source directs the annual Thái Tuế review toward stars in Tam phương and Đối chiếu context, without defining their geometry in this passage.
contextualStatements.sourceLocator: 論流年太歲吉凶星殺; revision 2268626, raw lines 117–118
limitations: No annual prediction or personalized reading is admitted.
